name: The Barrow of Kings
author: Patchwork
description: An ancient burial mound, newly broken open: dark chambers, an ossuary, a flooded hall and a king's sanctum. Supplies a guardian with a profile, an important relic and key, a bronze door and a rune-sealed coffer for the story generator to use, lore, and two events (a stolen relic, a restless guardian). Its guardian fights back if Steel & Peril is loaded.
